scope.question: Does Abu Ubayd's own Gharib al-Hadith text contain the exact cistern-outlet gloss that Qurtubi attributes to him for الصنبور?

source_anchors.work: Abu Ubayd al-Qasim ibn Sallam, Gharib al-Hadith
source_anchors.bibliographic_statement: The digitized front matter identifies the New Series of Publications of the Ottoman Encyclopedia Society, series 92/2; part 1; first edition, Hyderabad Deccan, 1384 AH / 1964, under Muhammad Abd al-Mu'id Khan.
source_anchors.section_locator: صنبر entry (the report beginning with Quraysh calling Muhammad صنبور)
relevant_direct_text: Abu Ubayd transmits explanations of الصنبور as a palm-shoot/stump and as an individual without child or brother.
The retrieved text attributes to Abu Ubayd another sense outside that context: a tube in a water vessel made of iron or lead.
source_anchors.phrase_search_result: No match in the retrieved digital text of the work.
limits: The exact Qurtubi gloss is not present in the inspected صنبر entry.
This does not establish absence from every work, manuscript, edition, or uninspected section by Abu Ubayd.

source_anchors.work: Gharib al-Hadith, paginated digital text window

source_anchors.note: The ScribeTools page's edition imprint was not cross-identified with the 1964 imprint in the other digital rendering; retain as a separate pagination aid, not a confirmed edition crosswalk.

source_anchors.locator: The museum identifies the work as Bulaq 1282 AH / 1865, volume 2, scan page 465.
source_anchors.note: This separate scan page was not visually checked against the page image, its scan-page number was not equated with printed pagination, and its OCR is explicitly cautioned as error-prone. It was not used to establish the target wording.

finding.confirmed: A direct Abu Ubayd work is now identified with edition-level front-matter metadata. In the retrieved صنبر entry, Abu Ubayd's wording supplies other senses but not the special مثعب الحوض gloss.
finding.secondary_witness: Al-Jawhari's al-Sihah electronically attributes the cistern-outlet sense to Abu Ubayd, but independence from Qurtubi and the Najaf page's printed edition remain unestablished.
finding.attribution_boundary: Do not claim the exact specialized gloss has been verified in Abu Ubayd's own text. Preserve Qurtubi's report attribution as written and describe the primary-source comparison as limited to the inspected entry.
not_established: Whether Abu Ubayd gives the cistern-outlet gloss in another work or uninspected passage.
Whether the Najaf p. 272 electronic text corresponds to the identified Bulaq edition.
Whether the Al-Jawhari and Qurtubi wordings are independent witnesses.
